019package org.tquadrat.foundation.exception;
020
021import static java.lang.System.lineSeparator;
022import static java.util.Collections.unmodifiableMap;
023import static java.util.stream.Collectors.joining;
024import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
025import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.CommonConstants.EMPTY_STRING;
026import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.isNull;
027import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.mapFromNull;
028import static org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects.requireNonNullArgument;
029
030import java.io.Serial;
031import java.util.ArrayList;
032import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
033import java.util.List;
034import java.util.Map;
035import java.util.StringJoiner;
036
037import org.apiguardian.api.API;
038import org.tquadrat.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
039import org.tquadrat.foundation.lang.Objects;
040
041/**
042 *  <p>{@summary A wrapper exception that can be used as base class for a
043 *  domain specific root exception.}</p>
044 *  <p>The derived exception classes can be used exclusively as a wrapper for
045 *  other exceptions. It does not populate the stack trace.</p>
046 *  <p>When wrapping other instances of {@class}, their {@code cause} is stored
047 *  as the cause of the new instance.</p>
048 *
049 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
050 *  @version $Id: WrapperException.java 1300 2026-11-21 11:51:20Z tquadrat $
051 *  @since 0.25.16
052 *
053 *  @UMLGraph.link
054 */
055@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: WrapperException.java 1300 2026-11-21 11:51:20Z tquadrat $" )
056@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.16" )
057public abstract class WrapperException extends RuntimeException
058{
059        /*------------*\
060    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
061        \*------------*/
062    /**
063     *  <p>{@summary The container for the additional information.}</p>
064     */
065    private final Map<String,List<String>> m_AdditionalInfo = new LinkedHashMap<>();
066
067        /*------------------------*\
068    ====** Static Initialisations **===========================================
069        \*------------------------*/
070    /**
071     *  The serial version UID for objects of this class: {@value}.
072     *
073     *  @hidden
074     */
075    @Serial
076    private static final long serialVersionUID = 11743602353543445L;
077
078        /*--------------*\
079    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
080        \*--------------*/
081    /**
082     *  <p>{@summary Constructs a new instance of this
083     *  {@class} with the specified detail message and cause.}</p>
084     *  <p>If {@code message} is {@null} and {@code cause} is an instance of
085     *  {@class}, the internal message of {@code cause} is used instead.</p>
086     *  <p>If {@code cause} is another exception type, the result of
087     *  {@link Throwable#toString() cause::toString}
088     *  is used as the detailed message for the new instance.</p>
089     *
090     *  @param  message The detail message that is saved for later
091     *      retrieval by the
092     *      {@link #getMessage()}
093     *      method. It can be {@null}.
094     *  @param  cause   The cause that is saved for later retrieval by the
095     *     {@link #getCause()}
096     *     method.
097     */
098    protected WrapperException( final String message, final Throwable cause )
099    {
100        final Throwable effectiveCause;
101        final String effectiveMessage;
102        if( requireNonNullArgument( cause, "cause" ) instanceof WrapperException wrapper )
103        {
104            effectiveCause = wrapper.getCause();
105            effectiveMessage = mapFromNull( message, cause::getMessage );
106        }
107        else
108        {
109            effectiveCause = cause;
110            effectiveMessage = mapFromNull( message, cause::toString );
111        }
112        super( effectiveMessage, effectiveCause );
113
114        //---* Replicate the additional info *---------------------------------
115        if( cause instanceof WrapperException wrapper )
116        {
117            if( !Objects.equals( message, wrapper.getInternalMessage() ) )
118            {
119                addInfo( "Additional Message", "%1$s: %2$s".formatted( wrapper.getClass().getName(), wrapper.getInternalMessage() ) );
120            }
121            for( final var entry : wrapper.getAdditionalInfo().entrySet() )
122            {
123                final var data = m_AdditionalInfo.computeIfAbsent( entry.getKey(), _ -> new ArrayList<>() );
124                data.addAll( 0, entry.getValue() );
125            }
126        }
127    }   //  WrapperException()
128
129    /**
130     *  <p>{@summary Constructs a new instance of this
131     *  {@class} that wraps the specified cause.}</p>
132     *  <p>If {@code cause} is an instance of {@class}, the detailed message
133     *  for this new instance is set to that from the cause.</p>
134     *  <p>Otherwise, the detailed message is set to the result of a call to
135     *  {@link Throwable#toString cause::toString}.</p>
136     *
137     *  @param  cause   The cause that is saved for later retrieval by the
138     *     {@link #getCause()}
139     *     method.
140     */
141    protected WrapperException( final Throwable cause )
142    {
143        requireNonNullArgument( cause, "cause" );
144        final var message = cause instanceof WrapperException wrapper
145            ? wrapper.getInternalMessage()
146            : cause.toString();
147        this( message, cause );
148    }   //  WrapperException()
149
150        /*---------*\
151    ====** Methods **==========================================================
152        \*---------*/
153    /**
154     *  <p>{@summary Adds information to this exception instance.}</p>
155     *
156     *  @param  key The information type.
157     *  @param  message The information data.
158     */
159    public final void addInfo( final String key, final String message )
160    {
161        final var data = m_AdditionalInfo.computeIfAbsent( mapFromNull( key, "[null]"), _ -> new ArrayList<>() );
162        data.addFirst( ( isNull( message) || message.isBlank() ) ? "<No Message>" : message );
163    }   //  addInfo()
164
165    /**
166     *  <p>{@summary This method does nothing.} Consequently, the
167     *  stacktrace for this exception instance does not get populated.</p>
168     *
169     *  @return A reference to this {@code Throwable} instance.
170     *
171     *  @see Throwable#printStackTrace()
172     */
173    @Override
174    public final synchronized Throwable fillInStackTrace() { return this; }
175
176    /**
177     *  <p>{@summary Return the additional infos.}</p>
178     *
179     *  @return The additional info.
180     */
181    protected final Map<String,List<String>> getAdditionalInfo()
182    {
183        final var retValue = unmodifiableMap( m_AdditionalInfo );
184
185        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
186        return retValue;
187    }   //  getAdditionalInfo()
188
189    /**
190     *  <p>{@summary Returns the internal message.}</p>
191     *
192     *  @return The internal message.
193     */
194    protected final String getInternalMessage() { return super.getMessage(); }
195
196    /**
197     *  {@inheritDoc}
198     */
199    @Override
200    public final String getMessage()
201    {
202        final var buffer = new StringJoiner( lineSeparator(), super.getMessage().concat( lineSeparator() ), EMPTY_STRING );
203        buffer.setEmptyValue( super.getMessage() );
204        for( final var info : m_AdditionalInfo.entrySet() )
205        {
206            buffer.add(
207                info.getValue()
208                    .stream()
209                    .collect( joining( "], [", "%s: [".formatted( info.getKey() ), "]" ) )
210            );
211        }
212
213        final var retValue = buffer.toString();
214
215        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
216        return retValue;
217    }   //  getMessage()
218}
219//  class WrapperException
220
221/*
222 *  End of File
223 */
